Subject: Concord PoC — onsite visit (Sept 14-15) — initial logistics

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for agreeing to host our two-day PoC at Redwood HQ on Sept 14-15. We're finalizing travel for five folks and I wanted to start the logistics thread so we can lock rooms, AV, badging, and the NDA flow. High-level asks from our side:

- A midsize room (12 pax) with hybrid camera and Zoom link for Day 1 demo and Day 2 workshop breakout
- Wired table for one demo laptop and a mic/podium
- Visitor badges on arrival + escort to meeting room
- NDAs: we can sign via DocuSign if you send a link; Concord security requires proof of signed NDA prior to any data access
- A place to store two loaner laptops overnight (secure closet or locked cabinet)

Attached is a draft agenda (Concord_PoC_Agenda_v2.pdf) and our completed visitor information sheet (Visitor_Badge_Form.xlsx). Can you confirm: 1) room assignment, 2) who will be the on-site escort, 3) preferred badging pickup window on Sept 14?

Appreciate it — Tara

--
Tara Singh
Director, Solutions Engineering
Concord Inc

Hi Tara — thanks for sending the agenda and badge form. Welcome — excited to host. Quick updates/questions: 

- Room: We'll reserve Conference B (capacity 14) for Sept 14 (9:00–17:00) and Suite 3 (workshop room) for Sept 15 (9:00–16:30). Conference B has an A/V cart, Polycam, and USB-C wired table.
- AV: Marcus (copied) will confirm the Zoom/streaming setup and make sure the wired table has a Thunderbolt adapter. If you need a dedicated HDMI dongle, please note it on the Visitor_Badge_Form.
- Badging: Badges are printed at lobby kiosks. Preferred pickup window is 08:30–09:00 on Sept 14; we'll have an escort meet the group in the lobby at 08:25.
- NDA: We'll send a DocuSign envelope by end of day; please have your legal signers on the DocuSign so we receive a completed copy before the demo.
- Loaner laptops: We can hold two laptops in a locked cabinet in IT Ops overnight. Please label them.

Two asks for you: 1) final attendee list with mobile numbers, and 2) any dietary restrictions for catering (we'll do light breakfast + lunch both days).

Attaching the internal run-of-show template that will help us coordinate (I'll upload to the shared drive after Marcus confirms AV).

Best,
Evelyn

--

Hey team — quick AV and ops notes (minimal but important):

- Conference B setup: Polycam will be ceiling-mounted; we'll stage the USB-C wired table on the presenter side. I will bring a Thunderbolt -> HDMI adapter and a USB-A hub.
- Network: We'll provision a guest SSID for the Concord team — please expect a short registration splash page (no VPN). If you need access to internal endpoints for demos, we can provide a temporary lab VM; that requires the signed NDA and confirmation of which IPs you need.
- Power: We'll reserve 2 power strips and an on-demand UPS for your demo laptop.
- Escort: Kimberly will act as primary escort and site contact (kimberly_park@redwood.ai / x4-712). If escorting multiple groups, we'll time the lobby pickup to avoid congestion.
- Safety: We require loaner devices to be logged into IT asset management before evening storage; please hand them to Kimberly at end of day for check-in.

Evelyn — sending the run-of-show template now to the drive (link below). Tara — if you can add which demos need external internet and which can run offline, that will help me set up policies ahead of time.

Thanks,
Marcus
